comment: Machine-independent perf gate. Each check is the throughput ratio of a motif bench to a baseline bench measured WITHIN a single run, so it is stable across CI runners (absolute hz is not). Budgets sit about 20% below the lowest ratio observed across three consecutive local runs, to absorb runner variance and sampling noise; a breach means motif regressed or the baseline closed the gap - investigate, do not blindly rebaseline. Reproduce with `yarn bench:check`. Run `yarn bench:check --update` to print the freshly observed ratios for a considered rebaseline. Baseline is @tamagui/core 2.x. The two data-table floors are lower than they were against 1.x because Tamagui 2.x is materially faster on that workload, not because motif regressed; the deep-tree and theme-switch floors rose over the same bump.
